snippet.title: Pikku Adventure — Learn a Complete Alien Language | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
🍄 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4428600/Pikku_Adventure/

Pikku Adventure is a 3D puzzle adventure where you learn a complete alien language word by word. Explore strange asteroid settlements, meet cute alien creatures, and decipher their language through observation, deduction, and empathy. No translations, no handholding -- just you and a language waiting to be understood.

Coming Fall 2026.

#indiegame #puzzlegame #languagegame #alienLanguage #godot #chantsOfSennaar
